institution.name: SMK – Statens Museum for Kunst (National Gallery of Denmark)

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1944. SMK marks this image as public domain (Public Domain Mark 1.0).
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1944 年。丹麦国家美术馆（SMK）将此图像标为公有领域（公有领域标记 1.0）。

alt.en: Two tall pine trunks with dark, rounded clumps of needles stand in snow in front of a wide blue-black fjord; a strip of white shore runs across the middle, and low hills lie along the far side under a grey sky.
alt.zh: 两棵高大的松树立在雪中，深色的针叶聚成圆团，面前是一片宽阔的蓝黑色峡湾；一条白色的岸线横过画面中部，对岸灰色天空下是低缓的山丘。

note.en: Munch is best known for more troubled pictures, but he also painted the Oslo fjord in winter, plainly and with affection; Nordstrand lies on the fjord just south of the city. The pines are reduced to flat shapes and the water to one deep colour, and the result is calm, almost a woodcut made in paint.
note.zh: 蒙克以更不安的画作闻名，但他也画冬天的奥斯陆峡湾，画得朴素而深情；诺德斯特兰就在城南的峡湾边。松树被简化成平面的形状，水被简化成一种深色，结果是安静的，几乎是一幅用油彩画成的木刻。
